notes: Plain "-L" SKU (no "Audio" suffix) has no analog audio Phoenix connectors — confirmed via retailer spec pages (Creation Networks, Nationwide Video) and Lightware's own naming convention, distinguishing it from the MX2-8x8-HDMI20-Audio-L which adds 5-pole Phoenix balanced-audio embed/de-embed jacks per port. Mechanical chassis, power, RS-232, Ethernet, and USB specs are shared across the -L/-Audio-L/-CA family and were verified against Lightware's official MX2-8x8-HDMI20 series User's Manual (rev 2.4) and the -Audio-L datasheet, since a standalone plain-L datasheet PDF could not be located. HDMI ports carry the router's rated 18 Gbps / 4K@60Hz 4:4:4 (up to 600 MHz pixel clock) bandwidth, i.e. HDMI 2.0 grade; DVI 1.0 and HDMI 1.4 are also supported for backward compatibility. RS-232 uses a 3-pole Phoenix/Euroblock connector (not DE-9); USB is a Mini-USB port on the front panel for local control/firmware via Lightware Device Controller software (no data grade specified, so omitted). Power is IEC C14 inlet, 100-240V AC, max 75W. Unit is 1U rack-mountable with included/removable rack ears.
